title: Changes inside Barber's program after the 2017 New York Times article

tellings.quote: When the New York Times article came out like 2017, uh it was really about then things started getting really weird for us

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew in a secret effort to recover unknown craft, says things inside his program "started getting really weird" around the time the New York Times published its 2017 article on the subject. He tells it as someone who was in the program then. To Barber, the timing suggests that the article's coming out changed how the people behind the program acted.
